title: eng-ml
text:
eng-ml

sara: Heads up — onboarding nocturne-v1 (int4) we’re seeing a weird morph/split regression for JP->ZH outputs when shortctx (<64) and KV cache enabled. BLEU drops ~3.2 vs fp16.
min: ugh. can you paste an example input/output? :eyes:
sara: sure — minimal repro.

```
input: "今日は学校へ行きます。"
fp16 output (expected zh): "今天我要去学校。"
int4 output (broken): "今天 我 要 去 学 校 。"
```

sara: note the extra spaces and token-level segmentation — detokenizer inserts spaces between morphemes, BLEU and chrF both suffer.
chen: are we sure it's quantization and not tokenizer mismatch? tokenizer version pinned in tests?
min: tokenizer v2.1.3 — same for fp16 and int4 runs. I ran the token maps and token ids align.
oleg: could be kvcache decode path — continuous batching + int4 kernel sometimes returns splits when cached prefix boundary occurs.
akiko: any failing unit tests or eval logs?
sara: CI eval shows this failing only on shortctx tests. Longctx (>=256) fine. I ran local bisect across kernels and found delta when switching to int4 dot-prod kernel v3.2.

ci-bot: build 2026-03-20T09:12:23 — nocturne-v1 int4 on cuda12, kernel v3.2 applied

min: can you share eval commands? I’ll try reproduce locally with pinned env.
sara: command below:

```
pytest tests/evals/multilang.py::test_nocturne_jp_zh --maxfail=1 -q 
export NOCTURNE_QUANT=1
export KV_CACHE_ENABLE=1
```

sara: sample diff from golden: fp16 detok: "今天我要去学校。" int4 detok: "今天 我 要 去 学 校 。"
chen: that looks like tokenization boundary insertion during decode — probably when KV cache returns subword boundary tokens separately. If merging fails uspace gets added by detok.
oleg: quick check: does disabling KV cache remove regression?

sara: yes — disabling kvcache makes int4 match fp16. So it's an interaction: int4 decoding + kvcache
min: hypothesis: quantized attention/kvcache kernel uses uint8 packing and an off-by-one when copying last token logits -> emits CHOMP tokens? Could also be softmax underflow causing high prob on whitespace token ids.
akiko: can we reproduce smaller: run a loop of single-step decodes with and without cache and dump logits for the problematic token positions.
sara: did that — attached snippet of logits (rounded):

```
step 1 logits (fp16, with cache): [..., id_123=9.8, id_44=8.1]
step 1 logits (int4, with cache): [..., id_123=9.8, id_44=12.4]
```

sara: whitespace token id (id_44) spikes in int4+cache path.
chen: interesting — suggests kernel mis-scaling or softmax temper mismatch. Any quant params different for kvcache path?
min: config check: quant config identical, but runtime uses deduped scaled-dot-prod for cache path (faster). That codepath has bespoke requantize step.
oleg: can we pin int4 to fallback kernel (safe slower) and see?
sara: pinned to safe kernel -> matches fp16. performance hit ~1.8x but fixes quality.
akiko: for triage: 1) reproduce with standalone unit test that asserts no extra spaces 2) bisect kernel commits 3) temporary rollback to safe kernel for customers until patched.
min: I’ll open a kernel bisect PR and add regression_unit in tests/evals (shortctx_kvcache_morph_regression).

sara: created gist with logs + reproducer: https://gist.github.com/redwood/nocturne-int4-kv-log
sara: also added eval summary: BLEU fp16=34.6, int4+kv=31.4, int4-no-kv=34.5
chen: thanks. please include hardware + driver info in the ticket (cuda, cudnn, GPU model).

sara: env: A100-80GB, cuda 12.1, driver 535.86, pytorch 2.2, triton kernels v3.2
oleg: I'll start the bisect, will post kernel commit ranges here.
min: PR #485 opened with test + fallback flag, marking as hotfix candidate :exclamation:
akiko: filing internal incident/incXXXXX so support + customers get notified.
sara: ping me if you need sample traces — I have full kvcache dumps.
chen: great. thanks everyone — prioritizing for MRP.
